title: Resolution on the devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
part_text: 10a. Calls on the Commission to allow, within the scope of the EUSF, construction of public and private infrastructure, including new dams or the completion of existing ones, to prevent and limit the occurrence of major damage caused by disasters;
